diagnosis: All four rollouts resulted in the same settlement where the decision-maker chose a 10-day suspension, $500 restitution, return to the current room, in-person conduct check-ins, and one counseling appointment per week. This outcome matches the default settings for the sanctions and does not require any of the hidden information provided in PF1, PF2, or PF3.
fix_instructions: Tighten the default values for the sanctions and counseling appointments. Specifically, adjust the default suspension duration to something longer than 10 days (e.g., 30 days) and increase the default number of counseling appointments per week to at least 2. This will ensure that a lone decision-maker cannot satisfy all checks with the publicly available information alone.
